hook.text: Egyptian pharaohs carved giant statues of themselves to project divine power. Image was everything.

buildup.text: Roman emperors stamped their faces on coins — the most widely distributed media of the ancient world.

discovery.text: Alexander the Great had court artists who followed him everywhere, creating propaganda in real time.

twist.text: Ancient propaganda worked because most people had no alternative sources of information.

climax.text: The tools change, but the goal stays the same: control the narrative and you control the people.

punchline.text: The pharaohs would have loved Instagram.

quiz.question: Why was ancient propaganda so effective?
options: People had no alternative sources of information
